d:
Relive the magic of “Bardaasht” from the blockbuster movie Humraaz in stunning 4K!
Starring Bobby Deol, Amisha Patel & Akshaye Khanna, this evergreen Bollywood song brings back the romance, drama and nostalgia of the early 2000s.
Song : Bardaasht
Singers : K K & Sunidhi Chauhan
Music : Himesh Reshammiya
Lyrics : Sudhakar Sharma
Director : Abbas - Mustan
Movie : Humraaz
